<entry id="T00303">
<head-word>רֹובָה</head-word>
<head-word>רֹובָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> = רַבָּא, 
<italic>great</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. II Lev. X, 19 (ed. Vien. רוּבָא).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> = רַבָּה 
<italic>elder, senior</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> bot. ר' הושעיא ר'. Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> ר' חייא ר'; a. fr. (interch. with רַבָּה).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00304">
<head-word>רוּבָּה</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= מְרוּבָּה) 
<italic>more, larger number</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 103
<sup>a</sup> ברכת הבית בר' the blessing of the household increases with the number of its members (every one contributing towards the comfort of all); B. Bath. 144
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. Keth. XII, 3 מרובה (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="T00305">
<head-word>רוּבָּה</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(רְבַב) 
<italic>gradation, conclusion a minori ad majus</italic> (= קַל וָחֹומֶר).</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah IV, 18
<sup>b</sup> top ר' דר' יוחנן ור' דר"ל there exists one argument a minori by R. J. and another by R. S. ben L.; ר' … מה מציאה וכ' R. J.’s argument is: if in the case of a find &c. (v. corr. vers in Frankel, Talm. Hierosol.).—ר', דר' (cmp. חֹומֶר I) 
<italic>something greater, more restrictive</italic>. Y. Sabb. XVII, beg. 16
<sup>a</sup> דלתות הבית דר' ודלתות הכלים דר' וכ' (not דרובן) in one respect there is a greater restriction in the law concerning the moving of the doors of a house, and in another respect a greater restriction in the law concerning the doors of furniture; דלתות … דר' וכ' the greater restriction concerning the doors of a house consists in this that they dare not be moved even &c. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40
<sup>a</sup> top ר' דר"ש ב"ל מדרבי וכ' the opinion of R. S. b. L. goes farther in restriction than that of R. J. Y. Maasr. I, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. דר' אתא אימור לך he comes to tell you something greater.—Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>c</sup> top דרַבָּה שהספרים וכ' here is something greater (than the difference between scrolls and T’fillin which has been stated): scrolls may be written on either side of the parchment &c.; דף אחד בשני עורות לית היא דר' the ‘one column’ law against the ‘two sides’ law—this is no gradation. Y. Peah I, 15
<sup>d</sup> top והוא דרבה מִנָּהּ גדול … כפריעת חוב וכ' (not בפריעת) here is something greater (just the reverse, v. אַדְּרַבָּא); greater is a duty which is like paying a debt (the filial duty) than &c.; Y. Kidd. I, 61
<sup>b</sup> bot. וההיא דרבנין (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>robʿa</italic>-ful of bones; a. fr.—בית ר' a piece of ground of the capacity of one 
<italic>robʿa</italic> of seed. Kidd. 26

<entry id="T00326">
<head-word>רָוַוח</head-word>
<head-word>רָוַח</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to be wide, roomy; to spread</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. I, 19
<sup>c</sup> top משם התורה יוצאה ורוֹוַחַת וכ' from there (the hall of the Sanhedrin) the law went forth and spread (with authority) for all Israel; Tosef. ib. VII, 1; Tosef. Ḥag. II, 9. Y. Yeb. I, 3
<sup>a</sup> bot. ראה … רווחת בישראל see how this decision will spread (what its effect will be) in Israel; a. e.—Part. pass. רָווּחַ; 
<plural-form>pl. רְווּחִים</plural-form>. Ab. V, 5, a. e. משתחוים, ר', v. צָפַף; [Mish. ed. רְוָחִים, 
<plural-form>pl. of רָוָח</plural-form>.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רוּוָּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be placed wide apart</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. מְרוּוָּח; f. מְרוּוַּחַת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְרוּוָּחִים, מְרוּוָּחִין; מְרוּוָּחוֹת</plural-form> (or מְרֻיָּו'). Y. Shebi. II, end, 34
<sup>b</sup> במר' when the trees are planted wide apart, opp. רצופין; Y. M. Kat. I, 80
<sup>c</sup> top; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be wide and flat</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to VII, 23 מקום מר', v. רֶוַוח. Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 6 לשונות מר' R. S. to Kel. XVIII, 5 wide and flat straps (comfortable to lie on), v. לוּחַ I.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִרְוִיחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of רֶוַח) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be relieved</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make profit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 13 משא … מַרְוִיחִין commerce is prosperous, and the dealers make profit; אף … מרויחין even the lepers feel relieved; Yalk. ib. 20. Gen. R. s. 39 החולה … ומַרְוִיחַ the sick man saw him (Abraham) and felt better. Yalk. Ps. 843, v. רֶוַוח; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause relief</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 34 מרויחין לו they (the visitors) bring him some relief; Midr. Till. to Ps. XLI.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְרַוֵּוחַ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְרַוֵּוחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be relieved, be in comfortable circumstances</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. l. c. לכשאתה מִתְרַוּוֵחַ וכ' when thou art in better circumstances, thou wilt repay me.—[Ib., a. e. נתרווח העולם, read: נִתְרַוֶּוה, v. רָוָה.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="T00327">
<head-word>רְוַוח</head-word>
<head-word>רְוַח</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be wide, extend; to be easy</italic>; ר' ל־ 
<italic>to feel relieved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XXXII, 20.—[Targ. Ps. XXIII, 5 רויחא Ms., ed. Lag. רווחא, v. רְוִיתָא.]—Snh. 7
<sup>a</sup> כיון דר' ר', v. בִּדְקָא. Ḥull. 8
<sup>a</sup> בית … מִירְוַוח ר' the cut widens, i.e. the parts cut through go apart, and are not affected by the heat of the knife. B. Bath. 90
<sup>b</sup> תרעא דר' ר' when the market becomes easy (prices fall), it remains so (for the rest of the year). Taan. 23
<sup>b</sup> אמינא … ר' עלמא וכ' (Ms. M. דוו, corr. acc.) I thought, as it has been raining, the world is at ease (prices will come down). Keth. 80
<sup>b</sup>, v. רַוְוחָא. B. Bath. 167
<sup>a</sup> (suspecting an erasure in a document) מ"ט רְוִיחַ ליה עלמא להאי וי"ו why has this Vav so much space?, opp. דחוק; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XX, end, 17
<sup>d</sup> נפל ביתיה על מאן דרויח עליה his house fell in over him who felt at ease (?), v. צְנִינִים.—[</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make room</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XLIX, 20 רְוַח לי (prob. to be read: רַוַּח 
<italic>Pa.</italic>; h. text גְּשָׁה.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>רַוַּוח, רַוַּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to widen, make room; give comfort</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XVIII, 16 (h. text ירחיב).—Part. pass. מְרַוַּוח; f. מְרַוְּוחָא; 
<plural-form>pl. מרַוְּוחִין; מְרַוְּוחָן, מְרַוְּח'</plural-form>. Targ. Jer. XXII, 14.—
<pgbrk id="pg1457" /></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of רוּחַ) 
<italic>to inspire</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. as ab. Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 24 [read:] מְרַוְּוחֵי רוּחִין בישין possessed by evil spirits.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַרְוַוח, אַרְוַח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make room, widen; to relieve</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XXVI, 22. Targ. Lam. III, 56 לאַרְוָוחוּתְנִי (verbal noun); a. e.—Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup> האי כוחלא … מַרְוַוח (or מְרַוַּוח 
<italic>Pa.</italic>) stibium widens (improves the eye-sight) up to forty years of age, מכאן … אַרְוָחֵי לא מרווח after that … it preserves the eye-sight, but does not improve it; a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מַרְוַוח

<sup>a</sup> במקום רחוק (corr. acc.). Gen. R. s. 19 (play on לרוּחַ היום, Gen. III, 8) לרי' היום for the extension of the day (in order to extend Adam’s day to God’s day, a thousand years); Pesik. R. s. 40 יום משלי … לר' היום וכ' I will give him one of my days,—‘to the extension of the day’—I will give him &c. Ḥull. V, 3 בזמן שאין לו ר' when there is no interval of time between the sale of the dam for slaughter and that of her young. Koh. R. to I, 7 ארבע … ר' בין וכ' there was a space of four cubits between each two. Ber. 15
<sup>b</sup> שיתן ר' בין הדבקים he must allow an interval between words that may easily run into each other; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<sense>

<sup>b</sup> משמתו … נסתלקה רוה"ק וכ' with the death of the last prophets, Haggai …, the prophetic spirit was withdrawn from Israel. Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> חזאי לי ברוה"ק וכ' I saw in a prophetic vision that unworthy children would go forth &c.; a. v. fr.—Snḥ. 65
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ר' טומאה unholy inspiration (augury &c.).</notes></sense>
<sense>

IV, 20) את שמוּרָם קודש וכ' that which is separated is to be sacred, and the remainder secular, but (no Ḥallah is to be taken,) when both would be sacred. Zeb.
